Title: New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules, 2019 (as amended)
Note: GSR 227(E), 19-03-2019. Covers new drugs, investigational new drugs, clinical trials, BA/BE studies and ethics committees. CDSCO copy shows 2022 amendments; check for the latest.

Title: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 and Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945
Note: Parent law for drug manufacture, sale and import in India. Find the Act and Rules in the CDSCO website's Acts & Rules section.

Title: CDSCO status at ICH (observer)
Note: Joined ICH as observer in Feb 2016 (no voting rights) per a March 2020 report. Verify current status on ich.org. ICH guidelines are technical references; binding law in India is the D&C Act/Rules and NDCT Rules.

Title: CDSCO Good Clinical Practice guidelines (draft)
Note: Draft released Sept 2024 for 30-day consultation; aligned with NDCT Rules 2019 and draws on ICH E6(R3). Link is a secondary summary; check cdsco.gov.in for final status.

Title: Indian Pharmacopoeia (IP) - monographs incl. paracetamol and ibuprofen
Note: Legal quality standards (identity, purity, strength). IP 2022 is the edition I have; IPC has announced a 2026 edition, so check the latest before citing.

Title: Pharmacovigilance Programme of India (PvPI)
Note: Launched July 2010; coordination centre moved to IPC in April 2011. ADR reports for any drug, including paracetamol and ibuprofen, go through this network.

Title: National List of Essential Medicines (NLEM) 2022
Note: 384 medicines; NLEM drugs fall under NPPA price control. Confirm the exact paracetamol and ibuprofen entries (strengths/levels of care) in the analgesic/NSAID section.

Title: ICH E6(R3) Good Clinical Practice
Note: Finalised Jan 2025. Global GCP standard behind India's clinical trial practice; link opens ICH Efficacy guidelines page.

Title: ICH E2E Pharmacovigilance Planning
Note: Framework for safety specification and pharmacovigilance plans; relevant to PvPI-style post-marketing monitoring.

Title: ICH E2C(R2) Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report (PBRER)
Note: Periodic safety reporting format; India's PSUR requirements are separate but related.

Title: ICH Q1A(R2) Stability Testing of New Drug Substances and Products
Note: Basis for stability studies of paracetamol and ibuprofen dosage forms. The Q1 series is under revision; check ich.org for the current version.

Title: ICH Q2(R2) Validation of Analytical Procedures
Note: Applies to assay and related-substances methods (e.g. HPLC/UV) for paracetamol and ibuprofen.

Title: ICH Q3A(R2) Impurities in New Drug Substances
Note: Reporting, identification and qualification thresholds for drug substance impurities (e.g. 4-aminophenol is a known paracetamol related substance).

Title: ICH Q3B(R2) Impurities in New Drug Products
Note: Degradation products in finished dosage forms.

Title: ICH Q3C(R8) Residual Solvents
Note: Permitted daily exposure limits for residual solvents in APIs and products.

Title: ICH Q3D(R2) Elemental Impurities
Note: Risk-based control of elemental impurities in drug products.

Title: ICH Q6A Specifications: Test Procedures and Acceptance Criteria (Chemical Substances)
Note: Framework for setting specifications for drug substances and tablets/oral liquids.

Title: ICH Q8(R2) Pharmaceutical Development
Note: Quality by Design principles for formulation development.

Title: ICH Q9(R1) Quality Risk Management
Note: Risk management framework across the product lifecycle.

Title: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System
Note: Quality system model that complements GMP.

Title: ICH M4(R4) Common Technical Document (CTD)
Note: Standard dossier format for registration applications.

Title: ICH M9 Biopharmaceutics Classification System-based Biowaivers
Note: Criteria for waiving in vivo BE studies for some oral products; check the drug's BCS class in the literature before applying.

Title: Paracetamol: mechanism of action, applications and safety concern
Authority: Acta Pol Pharm (Jozwiak-Bebenista M, Nowak JZ)
Note: PMID 24779190. Covers mechanisms, uses and hepatotoxicity risk with high doses (>4 g/day). Paracetamol.

Title: An Updated Review on the Metabolite (AM404)-Mediated Central Mechanism of Action of Paracetamol (Acetaminophen)
Authority: J Pain Res (Mallet C, Desmeules J, Pegahi R, Eschalier A)
Note: PMID 37016715. Central, COX-independent analgesic mechanism via AM404; notes NAPQI-mediated liver necrosis at high doses. Paracetamol.

Title: Ibuprofen: pharmacology, efficacy and safety
Note: PMID 19949916. Comprehensive review of ibuprofen pharmacology, clinical use and safety, including comparison with paracetamol. Ibuprofen.

Title: Single dose oral ibuprofen plus paracetamol (acetaminophen) for acute postoperative pain
Authority: Cochrane Database Syst Rev (Derry CJ, Derry S, Moore RA)
Note: CD010210. Three trials (1647 people): the combination outperformed either drug alone. Both drugs. Link goes to the Cochrane page.

Title: PubMed live search: paracetamol systematic reviews
Note: Always-current list of systematic reviews on paracetamol.

Title: PubMed live search: ibuprofen systematic reviews
Note: Always-current list of systematic reviews on ibuprofen.

Title: PubMed live search: paracetamol or ibuprofen with India affiliation
Note: Studies with an Indian author affiliation; useful for India-specific data.
